Title: Example row - the shape of an owner decision brief
OneLine: the one-line form status.md projects - what is being decided, and the recommendation in a clause
Decision: What is being decided, who raised it and when, and any context a ruler needs that is not obvious from the one-line.
BlastRadius: What breaks or changes if this is ruled either way - the honest cost, not the optimistic one.
Options: Option (a) ... · Option (b) ... · Option (c) ... - each with its FOR and AGAINST, separated by the middot the other registries use for lists-in-cells.
Recommendation: The driver's recommendation and WHY, in the same voice a reviewer would argue it.

Title: Decide: keep or drop the legacy export flag
OneLine: rule the legacy export flag (blocks: G1) - rec: drop it unless a consumer is named
Decision: Whether the legacy export flag stays in scope for v1 (blocks: G1).
BlastRadius: Every consumer of the legacy format, and the SR that would carry it.
Options: keep and specify it · drop it · defer behind a flag until a consumer asks
Recommendation: drop it unless a real consumer is named - an unspecified flag is a support cost with no owner.

Title: Pinning SR-000's acceptance predicate
OneLine: rule the acceptance predicate for SR-000 - rec: the measurable form
Decision: Which measurable predicate SR-000 is accepted against.
BlastRadius: The TC that verifies it, and any LLR decomposed from it.
Options: the measurable form · the descriptive form the draft carries
Recommendation: take the measurable form - a predicate a test cannot evaluate is not acceptance.
